description: Test suite for session management in Mattermost, including session timeout, promotion/demotion, session length, expiry extension, cloud session retrieval, remote cluster sessions, session limits, and extra session properties.

methods.name: TestGetSessionIdleTimeoutInMinutes
methods.description: Tests session timeout behavior based on last activity, including OAuth and personal access tokens.

methods.name: TestUpdateSessionOnPromoteDemote
methods.description: Verifies session updates when promoting a guest to user and demoting a user to guest.

methods.name: TestApp_GetSessionLengthInMillis
methods.description: Checks session length calculations for different session types and properties.

methods.name: TestApp_ExtendExpiryIfNeeded
methods.description: Tests the logic for extending session expiry based on activity and configuration.

methods.name: TestGetCloudSession
methods.description: Validates retrieval of cloud sessions based on environment variable and token matching.

methods.name: TestGetRemoteClusterSession
methods.description: Tests retrieval of remote cluster sessions with valid and invalid tokens and IDs.

methods.name: TestSessionsLimit
methods.description: Ensures session limit enforcement and correct removal of oldest sessions.

methods.name: TestSetExtraSessionProps
methods.description: Verifies updating session properties and avoiding unnecessary updates.
